summary: Verified new xoks-game product end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass. GET /api/products returns 4 active products including xoks-game (price 49.90, colors=[Azul,Amarelo,Laranja,Verde], gallery of 4, tagline 'Game Core'). GET /api/products/xoks-game returns all 3 specs (Multi-Layer Composite Technology™, Camada protetora anti-riscos, Design ergonómico e ultraleve) and sizes S/M/L/XL. All 4 /game-*.png images return 200 with image/* content-type. Frontend /produto/xoks-game shows name, Game Core, 49,90 €, all 3 specs in DOM, 4 color swatches; clicking color-option-Verde swaps product-main-image to /game-green.png and updates 'Cor: Verde' label. size-guide-btn opens size-guide-dialog with correct rows S(13cm/32-35cm)/M(15cm/35-38cm)/L(17cm/38-42cm)/XL(19cm/42-46cm). Add to cart works and toast description includes color + size. /produtos grid shows all 4 product cards including xoks-game; navigation works. Regression full checkout flow succeeded (/produto -> add -> checkout-btn -> /checkout -> place-order-btn -> /sucesso/XOKS-1011). No console errors (only a benign shadcn Dialog aria-describedby warning).

issues: A11y: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription (console warning). Non-blocking but recommended to add a DialogDescription.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to SizeGuide to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductShowcase: color selector correctly maps color.image -> gallery index. Good use of data-testid=color-option-{name}.
SizeGuide: static rows match spec exactly; measurements verified.
Backend seed order is deterministic and includes xoks-game featured product.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed transient records (product/athlete/partnership/order) created and deleted by pytest. One order XOKS-1011 created via full checkout regression (mirrors previous iterations pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline: 4 active products (xoks-pro-elite, xoks-carbon-blue, xoks-stealth-ankle, xoks-game) and 5 athletes. Only xoks-game has colors[]. Color swatches use data-testid=color-option-{Azul|Amarelo|Laranja|Verde} and clicking them updates product-main-image src to the matching /game-<color>.png. Size guide uses data-testid=size-guide-btn / size-guide-dialog / size-row-{S,M,L,XL}.
